title: Oxygen Mounts
description: A local .mounts.json: where this machine finds named source mounts. Never committed.

mount_name.description: A mount name: the first segment of every mount path in it. It follows the virtual path mount rule and never starts with '.'.

root.description: True stops the search: no .mounts.json above this one is read.

mounts.description: Mount name to folder (a loose cooked root or a .pak file for a Cooked mount): absolute, or relative to this file's folder.
